name: MIN
description: MIN returns the smallest value in a range of cells.
tldr: MIN finds the lowest value in a range.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, cell reference, or range.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Optional additional numbers, cell references, or ranges.

basicExample.description: Find the lowest value in a range
basicExample.explanation: Returns the smallest number from cells A1 through A10.

advancedExamples.title: Min with criteria using MINIFS
advancedExamples.description: Find the minimum value that meets specific criteria
advancedExamples.explanation: MINIFS finds the lowest value in column A where column B matches "Region A".

howItWorks: MIN scans all numeric values in the specified range and returns the smallest one, ignoring text, blank cells, and logical values.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the minimum value.

limitations: MIN ignores text and blank cells.

commonErrors.fix: Check your data range contains numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MIN works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does MIN consider dates?
faq.answer: Yes, dates are stored as serial numbers, so MIN can find the earliest date.
